stories.title: Meta says it is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero goal as AI data centers push emissions up 45%

facts.text: Meta acknowledges that it’s time to consider whether timelines for its long-term and short-term reduction targets should be updated.
The company’s net carbon footprint — which includes the impact of contractual instruments — jumped 45 percent last year, reaching 11.9 million metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (mtCO2e).
Meta’s location-based emissions inventory was almost twice that amount: 21.7 million mtCO2e.

“We are re-evaluating our timelines, sequencing and interim milestones — including the 2030 timeframe for our net-zero emissions goal and our near-term intensity targets — so our approach reflects current operating realities while keeping progress transparent year over year.”
Peterson and Swedeen did not provide a timeline for disclosing decisions related to that evaluation
That mirrors a 35 percent increase in power consumption, driven by new data centers.
Microsoft’s footprint jumped 25 percent; Amazon posted a 16 percent increase (including its e-commerce network); and Google disclosed an 18 percent year-over-year bump.
Meta is the first of the foursome to publicly state it will reconsider its timelines.

articles.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
Riemannsche Vermutung: Anthropic-Mathematiker will KI-Beweis gefunden haben

facts.text: The mathematician saw his employer, Anthropic, become the first publicly traded frontier AI lab. He also appears to have solved one of the most important problems in mathematics.
The hypothesis conjectures that there is a hidden structure underlying the appearance of prime numbers.
“The precise timing is horrible,” he wrote in an essay announcing his findings
which dates back to 1859 and is among the Millennium Prize math problems.
Levent Alpöge, hauptberuflich beim KI-Unternehmen Anthropic tätig, hat einen möglichen Beweis der Riemannschen Vermutung angekündigt.
Erste unabhängige Prüfungen zeigen, dass der Lean-Code fehlerfrei kompiliert und von zwei unabhängig entwickelten Lean-Kerneln akzeptiert wird.
Eine allgemein anerkannte Lösung liegt damit noch nicht vor.
Für eine anerkannte Lösung ist ein Preisgeld von einer Million US-Dollar ausgelobt.
Mathematiker haben inzwischen mindestens zehn Billionen nichttrivialer Nullstellen berechnet, und alle liegen auf der ½-Linie.

articles.title: OpenAI research agents cost $2,400 a day per researcher, report says

facts.text: OpenAI says its coding agents now complete 46% of research tasks that would take a person two to four hours, with no human help. In March the figure was 23%.
For tasks of four to eight hours, success rose from 13% to 35%.
At API list prices, the median OpenAI researcher used about $2,400 of agent time a day in October. That is up 62% from $1,500 in September.
Measured in time, agent use per researcher rose elevenfold, from 0.5 to 5.7 “agent workdays” a day.
Agents succeeded alone 79% of the time when monitoring training runs, and 72% when answering technical questions. They managed 25% when writing code for inference and serving systems
OpenAI says labs should be required to track and publicly report signs of recursive self-improvement
In interviews, researchers said agents still have poor taste in research ideas, code, data and writing, and need close oversight.
OpenAI flags a caveat in its own numbers. As agents improved, researchers may have changed which tasks they handed over

articles.title: Fünf EU-Staaten wollen Zentrum für KI in der Verteidigung gründen

facts.text: Deutschland, Frankreich, Italien, Polen und Schweden wollen gemeinsam ein internationales Zentrum für künstliche Intelligenz in der Verteidigung gründen.
Ziel der geplanten Organisation mit Sitz in Rennes ist es, den Einsatz von künstlicher Intelligenz zur Unterstützung militärischer Operationen zu beschleunigen.
Im Sommer 2027 soll das Zentrum, genannt International Centre for Artificial Intelligence in Defence (ICAID), demnach seine Arbeit aufnehmen.
An der Konferenz am Donnerstag und Freitag nahmen Vertreter von insgesamt 22 Ländern teil.
Ursprünglich war das Projekt als NATO-Exzellenzzentrum geplant – Frankreich treibt es nun aber selbst voran, eine NATO-Akkreditierung soll später folgen.
Bei einem zweiten Treffen im März 2027 sollen die teilnehmenden Länder ihre Zusagen formalisieren.
Es sollen laut französischem Verteidigungsministerium zunächst mindestens 34 zivile und militärische Arbeitsplätze entstehen, von denen 17 mit französischen Staatsangehörigen besetzt werden.

stories.title: Signal limits screenshots on Android and iOS to keep OS-level AI agents from reading chats

articles.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance

facts.text: Signal announced Friday that it’s limiting users’ ability to take screenshots within the secure messaging app
President Meredith Whittaker described as the “existential threat” of operating systems that integrate agentic AI.
Windows, Android, and macOS/iOS “are undermining Signal’s ability to independently guarantee privacy.”
Signal already sought to limit these risks by blocking screenshots of its Windows app by default. Now it’s adding similar restrictions in Android and iOS.
users can disable this setting if they wish, which Whittaker said would “break our privacy guarantees.”
She also admitted this is an “incomplete” solution

facts.text: Some 550,000 applicants had to take the exam while emergency disaster alerts sounded three times throughout the day.
“Perhaps because of my age, I don't think I could,” he replied, provoking public outrage.
The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission had already received 44 petitions through its online complaint portal calling for measures against AI-assisted cheating.
Cheating involving AI had surfaced in a national examination in May, while another case was detected during a university essay examination last month.
authorities should also examine how extensively AI has been used for cheating in previous CSAT examinations since generative AI became widely available.

The Education Ministry has vowed “zero tolerance” against those who cheat on the upcoming college entrance exam, with plans to dispatch specialized personnel to detect smart glasses at 1,312 test sites nationwide.

articles.title: 스페이스X, '커서'의 중국 AI 모델 퇴출 검토

facts.text: 스페이스X의 AI 코딩 플랫폼 커서(Cursor)가 중국산 AI 모델의 사용을 단계적으로 중단하는 방안을 검토하고 있다.
커서는 자체 코딩 모델 '컴포저 2(Composer 2)'를 개발하면서 중국 문샷 AI의 '키미 K2.5'를 기반으로 활용한 바 있다.
이번 조사에는 에어비앤비와 도어대시도 참여했다.
에어비앤비는 고객 지원 업무에 알리바바의 AI 모델을 활용하고 있으며
미국 의회는 대응책으로 공공 컴퓨팅 자원과 공동 평가 인프라를 결합한 '미국 국가 오픈웨이트 이니셔티브' 구축을 제안했다.
연방기관 정보시스템과 정부 계약 수행 과정에서 중국산 AI 모델 사용을 금지하는 방안도 권고했다.
트럼프 행정부는 미국 기업들이 중국산 AI 모델을 사용하는 사실을 공개하도록 의무화하는 방안도 검토 중이다.

articles.title: 머스크의 우주 데이터센터, 첫 금융 장벽…채권단 "GPU 반입 제한"

facts.text: 스페이스X에 수백억달러 규모의 GPU 구매 자금을 제공하는 채권단이 담보 회수가 어렵다는 이유로 반도체의 우주 반입을 제한하려 한 것으로 알려져
이번 제한 요구가 최종 계약에 반영됐는지는 확인되지 않았다.
스페이스X도 해당 GPU를 지상 데이터센터에 사용할 계획이라고 밝혀, 실제 우주 발사가 예정된 것은 아니다.
아폴로 글로벌 매니지먼트와 골드만삭스는 이날 공동 발표를 통해 약 440억달러 규모의 GPU 관련 채권 발행 조건을 확정했다고 밝혔다.
스페이스X가 지난 10월 발표한 약 400억달러 규모의 GPU 금융리스 약정과 관련된 것이다.
자금은 엔비디아의 차세대 '베라 루빈' GPU와 관련 장비를 확보해 미국 내 지상 데이터센터를 구축하는 데 사용될 예정이다.
머스크는 올해 초부터 2~3년 안에 우주가 데이터센터를 가장 저렴하게 운영할 수 있는 장소가 될 것이라고 주장해 왔다.

stories.title: METR updates its AI time-horizon chart: models still lag on judgment-heavy tasks

articles.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

facts.text: METR’s latest report finds that AI models are still improving at a rapid clip, but they show some weaknesses in tasks that require judgment.
every four months, the length of the tasks that frontier models could successfully complete doubled.
Not one of the AI-designed evaluations was good enough for METR employees to consider it useful for their research.
Some of the newest models, such as Opus 5.5, tend to achieve what METR calls “borderline above the bar” performance on the evaluation design tasks
Just a year ago, every model was scoring in the “clearly below the bar” category.
METR’s time horizon plots score task difficulty by evaluating how long it would take a human to complete the task
the completion times are mostly estimates, because paying people for tasks that might take hundreds of hours

articles.title: Satya Nadella says AI-found bugs will make outages more likely

facts.text: Satya Nadella expects more outages like the one that took down Outlook last week, because AI now finds software flaws faster than companies can safely fix them.
A fix for a critical bank system used to get a week of testing. Now attackers exploit flaws as soon as they surface, so fixes go straight into production.
Nadella also said the “floor of cyberattacks has fallen”.
He would ban models that reason in neuralese, an internal shorthand people cannot read.
Microsoft’s deal with OpenAI gives it royalty-free access to a frontier model until 2032, Nadella said.
“If you don’t accept the agent, somebody else will. If Amazon doesn’t, Shopify will,” Nadella said.
